texts.li: No rain or snow has fallen for four days, and the nights have been clear. {A_nameDef} has been up late every night looking at the stars, and says that a few more nights like this would answer questions the colony has been stuck on.

[tribal] The nights have been clear since the rain stopped, and every star is out. {A_nameDef} knows the stars the old people used to tell the seasons by, and wants to sit up with them while the sky is this clear, to check what the colony is working on against them.

[medieval] The sky has been clear for four nights running. {A_nameDef} has been up on the wall with a candle and a book, marking where the stars stand, and says the notes would help the colony's studies along if {A_pronoun} had a few more nights for it.

[industrial] Four dry days and four clear nights. {A_nameDef} has rigged up a telescope on the roof and has been taking readings until dawn, and says another night or two would settle a few problems in the colony's research.

[spacer] The sky has been clear for four nights, and {A_nameDef} has been watching the satellites and the old wrecks cross it, taking positions. With a few more clear hours {A_pronoun} could check the colony's research against what {A_pronoun} is seeing.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} sit up with the sky and the notes
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} sat out under the clear sky until the small hours, writing down what {A_pronoun} saw, and the colony's research is further along for it.

outcomes.li: [lowtech] {A_nameDef} lay out on the cold ground with a hide over {A_objective}, watching the stars move, and in the morning had worked out what the colony had been stuck on.
[!lowtech] {A_nameDef} took readings until dawn and spent the morning working through them, and the colony's research has moved on.

li.label: a night under the clear sky
Everyone out to look at the stars for an hour
li.outcome: The colony went out after supper and lay in the grass while {A_nameDef} pointed out the stars and named the ones {A_pronoun} knew. Most of them fell asleep out there.

li.label: Early to bed
li.outcome: The colony keeps its usual hours. The sky will be clear again another night.

texts.li: Fresh snow fell in the night, and this morning every animal that has moved on the colony's land has left a clear trail in it. {A_nameDef} says the game has never been easier to find, and it won't stay that way once the snow is trodden or the wind gets at it.

[lowtech] New snow lies over everything, and the tracks of every animal that moved in the night are written across it. {A_nameDef} is already restringing a bow, and says {B_nameDef} should come along and learn to read them.

[!lowtech] The snow that fell overnight shows every track on the land. {A_nameDef} has been out at first light with a rifle and says the game is easy to follow today, and that it's a good chance to show {B_nameDef} how.
[tundra] Fresh snow on the old snow, and the tracks of the caribou crossing the land are as clear as a road. {A_nameDef} wants to go out after them.

li.label: Send the hunters out while the tracks are fresh
li.outcome: The colony's hunters followed the clearest trails out from the colony, and two animals are marked to be brought in.

li.label: {A_nameDef} takes {B_nameDef} out to learn to read tracks
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} walked {B_nameDef} along the trails all morning, showing how to tell an old track from a new one and which way an animal was going. They took nothing home today, but {B_nameDef} will know the signs next time.

li.label: Stay in by the fire
li.outcome: The colony stays at its usual work, and by evening the wind has smoothed the snow over.

texts.li: The storm brought down several trees along the road outside the gate, and the logs are lying where they fell. {A_nameDef} has been out to look and says they're good wood. Word has also come from {FACTION} that the same storm took the roofs off some of their houses at {PLACE}.

[lowtech] The wind last night pulled trees out by the roots along the track outside the camp, and the trunks are lying across it. {A_nameDef} says there is a good deal of firewood in them. A runner from {FACTION} says the storm also wrecked shelters at {PLACE}.

[!lowtech] The storm knocked down a stand of trees by the road outside the gate, and the logs are lying there waiting. {A_nameDef} says it's good timber. A message from {FACTION} says the same storm tore roofs off at {PLACE}, and they're short of wood to repair them.
[winter] The winter storm brought down trees outside the gate under the weight of snow and wind. The logs are lying in the drifts. {FACTION} at {PLACE} lost roofs in the same storm.

li.label: Bring the wood in
li.outcome: Two of the colony spent the day carrying the logs in from the road and stacking them in the store.

li.label: Send 20 wood to {FACTION} for their roofs
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} carried a load of the wood out to the gate for {FACTION}'s people to take back to {PLACE}. They were glad of it.

li.label: Leave it where it fell for now
li.outcome: The logs stay by the road until someone has time to bring them in.
